key_features: Native 1080P HD: Delivers Sharp, Detailed Images With A Native 1920×1080 Resolution For A True High-Definition Experience.
Wireless Screen Mirroring: Features Latest Wifi Technology For Easy, Cable-Free Screen Synchronization From Ios And Android Devices.
Large 200-Inch Display: Projects A Massive Image Up To 200 Inches For An Immersive Home Cinema Experience.
Quiet Operation: Advanced Air Duct Design Reduces Noise By 20%, Operating At A Quiet ≤35db For Minimal Distraction.
Image Correction: Offers ±15° Vertical Keystone Correction And Supports Ceiling Mounting For Flexible Setup And Placement.
Built-In Stereo Sound: Integrated Dual Speakers With Hifi Stereo Audio Provide Clear, Powerful Sound Without External Speakers.
